**Date:** 19/12/2026

## Agenda

- 19:30  Recap: Session 7
- 19:35  8.1  Writing the paper (II): Introduction, Discussion, Abstract, Title
- 20:00  Manuscript workshop 2: Q1 together, then your own
- 20:30  8.2  Getting published: from checklist to reviewers
- 21:05  8.3  Be the reviewer: Papers 1 and 2, as a whole class
- 21:30  Proposal presentations (about 5 volunteers), 22:15 closing

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 5 | Recap |
| 0:05 | 19:35 | 25 | **8.1 Writing the paper (II):** Introduction funnel, Discussion six moves, calibrated language, abstract, title & keywords, before you submit |
| 0:30 | 20:00 | 30 | **[DS] Manuscript workshop 2:** Introduction, Discussion, Abstract and Title modelled live on Q1 (22 min); each participant writes their own aim and title (8 min) and completes their draft as homework |
| 1:00 | 20:30 | 20 | **8.2 Getting published:** reporting guidelines (**EQUATOR demo**), choosing a journal, predatory journals, submission package, peer review, responding to reviewers (preprints, rejection, proofs and conference abstracts in the extra slides) |
| 1:20 | 20:50 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:35 | 21:05 | 25 | **8.3 Be the reviewer:** simplified appraisal of Papers 1 and 2 (Boulet 2024 RCT and Hyun 2023 cohort, in `Course/Papers/`) with the whole class, using the 10-question checklist, as training for the individual peer review after the course |
| 2:00 | 21:30 | 45 | **Volunteer presentations:** about 5 volunteers present their own research proposal + publication plan (6 min + 2 min feedback each), then a 5-minute closing round; everyone submits slides and the written proposal |
| 2:45 | 22:15 | 15 | Post-course quiz, evaluation, next steps (individual peer review of one peer's manuscript as homework) |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows Vietnam time for the online 19:30–22:30 session. All exercises are done by the whole class together (no groups). **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Before this session

- Written proposal and 6 slides ready to submit (volunteers: presentation rehearsed, 6 minutes).
- Your Methods + Results draft and your results pack.
- The abstracts of Papers 1 and 2 read.

## After this session (homework)

- Finish the manuscript and submit it (see the [manuscript brief](manuscript-brief.qmd)).
- Peer review: review the one classmate's draft the instructor sends you, with the 10-question checklist, within 1 week; then answer the review of your own draft with the response-to-reviewers template within 2 weeks ([peer-review instructions](peer-review.qmd)).
- Writing exercises (Part A of the Session 8 sheet) for practice.
